messages:
Maya Chen: Heads-up: AcmeCorp dedicated pool switch is Wed 2026-05-13 09:30 PT. Need final acceptance on quota sizing, canary plan, and the mission-critical load script. Target steady QPS=1000, peak burst=2800, cache warmup ~25m.
Samir Patel: Confirming contract: committed steady 1k, burst allowance 2.8k. I'll post the signed clause and final numbers to the workbook in a sec.
Priya Nair: Customer asks that the big spike happens inside their engineering overlap (09:00-17:00 PT). They also want a controlled canary for 45m before full ramp.
Jordan Lee: Proposal for autoscale: min=3, max=16, cpu_target=65. Shorter cooldown to recover faster: cooldown_seconds=180. We'll watch for scale thrash.
Maya Chen: @Jordan please paste the exact block we'll apply to the autoscaler so I can include it in the runbook.
Jordan Lee: Here you go:
```
autoscaler:
  min_replicas: 3
  max_replicas: 16
  cpu_target_percent: 65
  scale_up_threshold_percent: 75
  scale_down_threshold_percent: 45
  cooldown_seconds: 180
```
Jordan Lee: We'll mirror that in the staging dry-run.
Eli Torres: Runtime note: shard imbalances cause token-rate spikes on cold starts. I'll schedule priming 25m before the canary: `./priming_tool --pool acme-dedicated --duration 25 --threads 6`. That should spread KV entries.
load-runner-bot: loadplan-uploaded: `profiles/acme_ramp_v2.yml` (steady 0->1k in 8m, hold 30m, spike 2.8k for 3m, then taper).
Samir Patel: Uploading runbook patch with the load file. Also adding a quick smoke test scenario for staging to validate error budget.
Priya Nair: We'll have two Acme SREs on the channel and one product owner monitoring. I'll share their handles 1hr before canary.
Jordan Lee: Canary gating rules: 95p latency <= 300ms, overall error rate <= 0.2% over 10m window. If breached, we pause traffic and revert to hosted routing.
Maya Chen: Rollback play (short): if errors > 0.6% for 5m, run `./traffic-shift --target hosted --note \"acme rollback\"` and page #oncall. Keep the commit id in the ticket.
ops-bot: pool-reserve: `acme-dedicated-2026-05` reserved starting 2026-05-13T16:00Z. Priming jobs scheduled at 16:05Z, canary begins 16:45Z (09:45 PT), full ramp at 17:30Z (10:30 PT).
Maya Chen: Quick checklist:
- [ ] Contract numbers posted & validated (Samir)
- [ ] Autoscale config applied in staging & dry-run logs (Jordan)
- [ ] KV priming executed 25m before canary (Eli)
- [ ] Load plan loaded & smoke-tested (Samir/load-runner-bot)
- [ ] Customer oncall confirmed for canary window (Priya)
- [ ] Rollback play documented and bookmarked (Maya)
Samir Patel: I'll drop the signed clause and the `acme_ramp_v2.yml` link by EOD.
Eli Torres: After the staging dry-run I'll post a short summary with warmup token profile and any shard hot spots. Expect that at 03:30 PT tomorrow.
Priya Nair: We're good to proceed as planned. I'll confirm the customer engineers in the morning.
Maya Chen: Great. Preflight scheduled 06:30 PT tomorrow, I'll run through the checklist then. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
